name: zolitron
description: This is the project of group zolitron-2

scripts.install:all:mac: concurrently "cd client && npm i" "cd backend && pip install -r requirementsMac.txt"
scripts.install:all:linux: concurrently "cd client && npm i" "npm run install:backend:linux"
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd client && npm run dev" "npm run backend" --kill-others --raw
scripts.dev:linux: concurrently "cd client && npm run dev" "npm run backend:linux" --kill-others --raw
